QUOTE: "`MBEDTLS_TEST_CONSTANT_FLOW_VALGRIND`: runs the constant-time suites under Valgrind memcheck... `MBEDTLS_TEST_CONSTANT_FLOW_MEMSAN`: the same idea with Clang MemorySanitizer... Neither runs by default in a normal build."
VERDICT: MISS
WHY: The answer describes the opt-in valgrind/MemSan testing and off-by-default, but never states that the facility is explicitly not part of the library API; the "Public API" remark concerns the ct primitives, not the testing facility.
